summary: Read one positive integer. Form the next value by adding the square of each decimal digit, and keep doing that. If a value becomes 1, judge the starting integer happy and write true. If the values enter a loop that never contains 1, write false. The integer 1 is happy because it stays at 1. Split digits in base 10 only. The chain may wander for a long time before it hits 1, and it still counts as happy whenever 1 appears.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
